regex-tester.title: Regular expression tester
regex-tester.shortDescription: Inspect JavaScript regex matches, capture groups and indexes locally.
regex-tester.description: Enter a pattern without surrounding slashes, optional JavaScript flags, and test text. Global or sticky flags return successive matches; other flags return the first match.
regex-tester.note: Runs only in an isolated Web Worker, terminated after 1 second. Maximum: 100,000 text characters, 2,000 pattern characters and 1,000 matches. Large capture output is also limited. Flags depend on your browser; indexes use UTF-16 positions. Unmatched groups are null. Empty patterns are allowed. Nothing leaves your browser.

errors.inputLimit: The text or pattern exceeds the supported size.
errors.regexInvalid: The pattern or flags are invalid or unsupported by this browser.
errors.regexUnavailable: An isolated worker could not start. Enable browser worker support and try again.
errors.regexTimeout: The expression exceeded the 1-second limit. The worker was terminated; simplify the pattern or shorten the text.
errors.outputLimit: The match count or capture output is too large. Narrow the expression or shorten the text.
errors.regexFailed: The isolated regex worker could not finish.

jsonpath-tester.title: JSONPath tester
jsonpath-tester.shortDescription: Select JSON values with a JSONPath expression, without executing code.
jsonpath-tester.description: Paste JSON and a JSONPath expression beginning with $. Results are always returned as a JSON array, including an empty array when nothing matches.
jsonpath-tester.note: Uses jsonpath-plus with evaluation disabled. Property access, wildcards, recursive descent, slices and unions are supported; code-based filters and script expressions are not. Maximum: 200,000 JSON characters and 2,000 expression characters. Processing stays in your browser.

errors.jsonpathInvalid: Enter a supported JSONPath expression beginning with $. Script evaluation and code filters are disabled.

sql-formatter.title: SQL formatter
sql-formatter.shortDescription: Format SQL locally with dialect-aware indentation and uppercase keywords.
sql-formatter.description: Choose the SQL dialect and format your query with two-space indentation. This formatter does not execute queries or verify database schemas.
sql-formatter.note: Uses sql-formatter in your browser. Dialect-specific syntax support depends on the formatter; formatting is not complete SQL validation. Maximum input: 200,000 characters.

errors.sqlInvalid: This SQL could not be formatted with the selected dialect. Check the syntax and dialect.

yaml-formatter.title: YAML formatter
yaml-formatter.shortDescription: Parse and reformat a YAML document with consistent indentation.
yaml-formatter.description: Format one YAML document using js-yaml's JSON schema. Syntax errors are reported without disclosing your input in the error message.
yaml-formatter.note: Single-document YAML only; custom tags are disabled. Comments, quote style and original anchor names are not preserved. Anchors and references may be rewritten. Dates remain strings under the JSON schema. Maximum input: 200,000 characters. Processing is local.

errors.yamlInvalid: Enter one valid YAML document using supported JSON-schema types.

env-parser.title: Dotenv and JSON converter
env-parser.shortDescription: Convert line-based environment assignments to JSON and back.
env-parser.description: Read dotenv assignments with optional export prefixes, comments, quoted values and escaped characters. Convert a JSON object of scalar values into safely quoted assignments.
env-parser.note: Keys must be ASCII identifiers. Single quotes are literal; double quotes use JSON escapes (such as \n and \\). No variable expansion, shell execution or physical multiline values. Unquoted # starts a comment. Duplicate assignments use the last value. JSON strings, finite numbers, booleans and null become strings; nested objects/arrays and prototype-related keys are rejected. Maximum: 200,000 characters. Output is for dotenv, not a shell script.

errors.objectRequired: The JSON input must be an object.
errors.scalarRequired: Values must be strings, finite numbers, booleans or null; nested values are not supported.
errors.envInvalid: Check assignment syntax, matching quotes and JSON-style escapes. Physical multiline values are not supported.
errors.envKeyInvalid: Environment keys must start with an ASCII letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits or underscores.

query-string-parser.title: Query string and JSON converter
query-string-parser.shortDescription: Decode query parameters and preserve repeated keys as arrays.
query-string-parser.description: Convert a URL query string into a JSON object, or encode a JSON object as form-style URL parameters. Repeated values keep their order within each key.
query-string-parser.note: Paste only the query, optionally starting with ?. A plus sign decodes to a space; literal plus signs must use %2B. Duplicate keys become arrays. JSON scalar values or arrays of scalars are accepted; null becomes the text null and empty arrays produce no parameter. Interleaved key ordering is grouped in JSON. Malformed percent escapes/UTF-8 are rejected. Maximum: 200,000 characters. Processing stays local.

errors.queryInvalid: The query contains invalid percent encoding or UTF-8.
errors.objectRequired: The JSON input must be an object.
errors.unsafeKey: Prototype-related keys cannot be encoded from JSON.
errors.scalarRequired: Use scalar values or arrays of scalar values, without nested objects or arrays.

url-parser.title: URL parser
url-parser.shortDescription: Inspect an absolute URL's components and repeated query parameters.
url-parser.description: Parse a URL using the browser's WHATWG URL implementation. Inspect its normalized address, origin, scheme, credentials, host, port, path, query and fragment.
url-parser.note: An absolute URL with a scheme is required; relative paths are not supported. The browser may normalize casing, default ports, spaces and internationalized hostnames. Non-network schemes can have a null origin. Credentials, if present, appear in the output. No URL is opened or requested. Maximum: 200,000 characters.

errors.urlInvalid: Enter a valid absolute URL without control characters.
errors.queryInvalid: The URL query contains invalid percent encoding or UTF-8.

curl-to-fetch.title: cURL to Fetch or Axios
curl-to-fetch.shortDescription: Turn a supported cURL command into JavaScript source without making a request.
curl-to-fetch.description: Parse a single HTTP(S) cURL command with POSIX-style quotes and generate Fetch or Axios source text for review. The generated code is never executed.
curl-to-fetch.note: Supported flags only: -X/--request, -H/--header, -d/--data, --data-raw, --url, -I/--head and --. Attached short values and --flag=value work. Single/double quotes and backslash continuations are supported; quote URLs containing shell metacharacters. Repeated inline data joins with &. Data defaults to POST with form content type. No files, URL credentials, expansion, substitutions, pipes, redirects, raw command separators or additional cURL flags. Empty/removal headers, prototype-related header names and GET/HEAD bodies are rejected. Browser forbidden headers, CORS and Axios serialization can differ from cURL; review generated code. Maximum: 200,000 characters and 1,000 tokens. Nothing is requested.

errors.inputLimit: The command exceeds the supported input or token limit.
errors.curlSyntax: Enter a single supported curl command with matching quotes and complete flag values.
errors.curlShell: Shell expansion, substitutions and unquoted shell metacharacters are not supported. Quote literal argument values.
errors.curlFlagUnsupported: The command uses an unsupported cURL flag. Check the supported flags in the note.
errors.curlMultipleUrls: Only one URL is supported per command.
errors.curlMethodInvalid: The HTTP method is invalid or unsupported by browser clients.
errors.curlHeaderInvalid: Use nonempty header-name: value arguments without control characters. Header removal syntax is not supported.
errors.curlFileUnsupported: Reading request data from a file is not supported. Use inline data or literal --data-raw text.
errors.urlInvalid: Enter a valid absolute URL without control characters.
errors.curlUrlUnsupported: Only HTTP(S) URLs without embedded credentials are supported.
errors.curlBodyUnsupported: Generated browser requests cannot have a GET or HEAD body.
